body: I'm having the same issue, but the other way around: Node is the default template when I want a custom one instead. I have a base scene with a custom script called `GISModule`, which is supposed to be inherited. When I select the root node and extend its script, the Attach Script dialog properly makes the new script inherit `GISModule`, but the default template is for Node. My template script is in the proper folder and the first lines contain the following: ```gdscript # meta-name: Module template # meta-description: Example module with basic functionality # meta-default: true ``` I have to manually select my template in order for it to be remembered, so not quite the expected behavior, and since the goal is to provide this to users in a way similar to a modding tool, those users will need to select the template manually as well. The current behavior means selecting the template manually will add an entry to `.godot/editor/project_metadata.cfg`: ``` [script_setup] last_selected_language="GDScript" create_built_in_script=false templates_dictionary={ "GISModule": "2GISModuleModule template" } ``` I'm using Godot 4.5 beta4 on Linux (Wayland editor).
